description: Typesets a CV with XeLaTeX (TeX Live 2026) on this machine and writes the PDF. Give structured `cv` data for the Classic, Modern or Academic template (Academic: Latin Modern with small caps, a skills table, education grouped by school), or your own LaTeX in `tex`/`texFile`. Projects and awards take one line as a paragraph, several as bullets. Only bundled packages are available (fontspec, geometry, xcolor, enumitem, titlesec, hyperref, tabularx, multicol, paracol, fontawesome5 and their dependencies); fonts: Linux Libertine, Biolinum, Latin Modern. The first call downloads the engine (~21 MB) from app.ionelul.com and caches it; the CV is never sent anywhere.
